description: Source-grounded SLIIT evaluation questions covering semester registration, examination timelines, reference-sheet rules and academic-performance scholarships.
evaluation_notes: Ten questions are answerable from the identified SLIIT indexed sources.
Two questions test abstention when exact scholarship details are not provided.
The semester timeline source was published on 10 June 2025 and describes general timelines, not guaranteed dates for a current semester.
Markdown source snapshots have indexed page metadata [1]. This is not an original PDF page number.
Lexical fact coverage is a proxy and must not be represented as semantic faithfulness.

questions.question: According to SLIIT's general timeline, when should students complete semester registration for the January-June and July-December semesters?
questions.expected_answer: Semester registration should take place four weeks before semester commencement. For the January-June semester the general period is December or January, while for the July-December semester it is May or June.
required_facts: Semester registration is four weeks before semester commencement
January-June semester registration is generally in December or January
July-December semester registration is generally in May or June

supporting_contexts.context: Semester registration: Four weeks before semester commencement. January-June semester: December / January. July-December semester: May / June.

questions.expected_answer: Late semester registration normally takes place one week into semester commencement, and penalty fees apply. The general periods shown are January for the January-June semester and June for the July-December semester.
required_facts: Late semester registration is one week into semester commencement
Penalty fees apply to late semester registration
January is the listed period for the January-June semester
June is the listed period for the July-December semester

supporting_contexts.context: Late semester registration (penalty fees apply): One week into semester commencement. January-June semester: January. July-December semester: June.

questions.question: Who decides whether a student may use a self-created reference sheet in a final examination under the May 2025 SLIIT notice?
questions.expected_answer: Following a Senate recommendation, faculties may permit one self-created A4-size reference sheet in final examinations at the discretion of the Lecturer-in-Charge (LIC). It is not an automatic entitlement for every examination.
required_facts: The reference-sheet arrangement follows a Senate recommendation
Faculties may permit one self-created A4-size reference sheet
Permission is at the discretion of the Lecturer-in-Charge

supporting_contexts.context: Following a Senate recommendation, faculties may permit one self-created A4-size reference sheet in final examinations at the discretion of the Lecturer-in-Charge (LIC).

questions.question: What format and content restrictions does the May 2025 SLIIT notice specify for a permitted examination reference sheet?
questions.expected_answer: The sheet must be one A4 page, handwritten or printed, and may use one or both sides. It must be concise and contain only material taught during the module; sample answers are not allowed. Students must prepare and use their own sheets and must not share them. The module name and candidate index number must appear at the top, and the sheet must be attached to the answer script.
required_facts: The reference sheet is limited to one A4 page
It may be handwritten or printed and use one or both sides
It must contain concise material taught during the module only
Sample answers must not be included
Students must not share reference sheets
The module name and candidate index number must appear at the top
The reference sheet must be attached to the answer script

supporting_contexts.context: The reference sheet is limited to one A4 page, handwritten or printed, and may use one or both sides. It should be concise and contain only material taught during the module. Sample answers must not be included. Students must not share reference sheets during examinations; each student prepares and uses their own sheet. The module name and examination candidate's index number must appear at the top. The reference sheet must be attached to the answer script.

questions.question: How does SLIIT's semester-based academic-performance scholarship recognise continuing undergraduate students, and do students need to apply?
questions.expected_answer: Undergraduate students ranking within the top 1% of their academic programme in a semester may receive full or partial tuition fee waivers. Students within the top 2% are also considered for partial scholarships. There is no application process; eligible students are identified through academic results and informed directly by the Academic Affairs Division. The awards are limited and competitive.
required_facts: Undergraduates in the top 1% may receive full or partial tuition fee waivers
Students within the top 2% are considered for partial scholarships
There is no application process
Eligible students are identified through academic results
Selected students are informed directly by the Academic Affairs Division
Scholarships are limited and competitive

supporting_contexts.context: Undergraduate students who rank within the top 1% of their academic program in a given semester may receive full or partial tuition fee waivers. Those within the top 2% are also considered for partial scholarships. There is no application process; eligible students are identified based on academic results and informed directly by the Academic Affairs Division. The number of scholarships is limited and competitive.

questions.question: What exact number of semester-based academic-performance scholarships is available each semester?
questions.expected_answer: The indexed scholarship source does not specify an exact number. Its 'Number available' field is marked 'TBD', and it describes the awards as limited and competitive.

questions.expected_answer: The indexed scholarship source does not provide a confirmed closing date; the closing-date field is marked 'TBD'.
